n519b156958.headline: Remy Cointreau lifts profit view as sales grow
n519b156958.summary: French spirits maker Remy Cointreau reported its first quarter of sales growth since early 2023 and raised its full-year profit guidance. The company cited receding tariff threats.
n519b156958.why: Remy Cointreau is a French cognac and premium spirits producer whose sales are sensitive to export markets and trade policy.
n519b156958.why_moved: A raised full-year profit outlook and a first quarter of sales growth since early 2023 are direct company updates that can reset expectations for the shares.

na1196ffd99.headline: Revenues at Irish arm of Dyson down 30% to €25m
na1196ffd99.summary: Directors at the Irish unit of Dyson blame increased market competition for revenues sliding 30% to €25.1 million last year.
na1196ffd99.why: Dyson is a British consumer appliance maker, and weak revenues at its Irish unit reflect pressure in its regional sales operations.

n61515c6e9a.headline: eClerx shares hit 52-week high as Q1 profit jumps 27% to ₹141.7 cr
n61515c6e9a.summary: eClerx Services shares rose to a 52-week high of ₹3,920.90 on Thursday. The company's first-quarter profit jumped 27% to ₹141.7 crore.
n61515c6e9a.why: eClerx is an Indian business process and analytics services provider, so its quarterly profit trends indicate demand for outsourced services.

nd6623ab2f9.headline: Warning for thousands of UK tourists heading to Portugal in July or August
nd6623ab2f9.summary: Ground workers plan to strike over five weekends at Portuguese airports in July and August, a warning for UK tourists travelling to Portugal in those months.
nd6623ab2f9.why: Airport labour disputes disrupt flights, tourism spending and airline operations. Tourism is a major contributor to Portugal's economy.

n15767ed7b8.headline: First Citizens BancShares Reports Second Quarter 2025 Earnings, Announces Additional Share Repurchase Plan
n15767ed7b8.summary: First Citizens BancShares reported second-quarter 2025 earnings and announced an additional share repurchase plan. The Nasdaq-listed bank holding company is based in Raleigh.
n15767ed7b8.why: First Citizens is a US bank holding company whose quarterly results and capital return decisions, such as buybacks, are closely watched by bank investors.

nccfe682c14.headline: South Africa to get $475m loan from African Development Bank
nccfe682c14.summary: South Africa has signed a $474.6 million loan agreement with the African Development Bank to help finance infrastructure and clean energy plans, National Treasury said.
nccfe682c14.why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender that funds infrastructure and energy projects across Africa, and sovereign borrowing affects public finances.

n9c1b6c4ae9.headline: Volkswagen takes $1.5B hit from tariffs
n9c1b6c4ae9.summary: Volkswagen was forced to trim its full-year earnings forecast and realign its business model, possibly with less US trade, executives said. The group booked a $1.5 billion hit from tariffs.
n9c1b6c4ae9.why: Volkswagen is a German carmaker whose global operations and export flows make it sensitive to tariffs and trade policy.

impacts.name: Volkswagen
impacts.why: Tariffs cost the group $1.5 billion and the full-year earnings forecast was reduced.

n2173b507dc.headline: Striking doctors accuse Wes Streeting of a 'slap in the face' of trade unions
n2173b507dc.summary: Striking doctors on picket lines demand higher pay, but Health Secretary Wes Streeting refuses to budge. He called the action unnecessary and reckless.
n2173b507dc.why: Doctor strikes disrupt NHS services and raise the fiscal cost of public-sector pay settlements in the UK.

nf9e5071049.headline: More Free Zone Companies Can Now Own Property in Dubai's Mainland
nf9e5071049.summary: Free zone companies in Dubai can now own property on the mainland without needing a mainland trade licence. The change widens the pool of corporate property buyers.
nf9e5071049.why: Dubai's real estate market is a major driver of its economy, and changes to ownership rules affect demand for mainland property.

nbdd112ca81.headline: Visa opens first Africa data centre in Johannesburg
nbdd112ca81.summary: Visa launched its first data centre in Africa in Johannesburg, part of a 1 billion rand investment. The company is targeting the region's rapid growth in digital payments.
nbdd112ca81.why: Visa is a global payments network whose processing infrastructure underpins card and digital transactions. Regional data centres support local payment volumes and compliance.

n75624f03f0.headline: Reliance Power hits lower circuit on enforcement action reports
n75624f03f0.summary: Reliance Power shares fell to the lower circuit limit after reports of enforcement agency action. The company said the reports would have no impact on its operations or financials.
n75624f03f0.why: Reliance Power is an Indian power generation company within the Reliance Group. Enforcement actions can affect investor confidence and the company's financing and governance outlook.
n75624f03f0.why_moved: Shares fell to the lower circuit limit after reports of enforcement agency action. The company said the reports have no impact on its operations or financials.

nf5b527e00a.headline: Tanzania banks on EACLC to generate 300bn/-in trade growth
nf5b527e00a.summary: TISEZA director general Gilead Teri said completing the East Africa Commercial and Logistics Centre will stimulate trade and lift annual goods exports above TZS 300bn.
nf5b527e00a.why: Logistics hubs and export growth shape trade flows and investment prospects for East African economies.

n1564ce9bdc.headline: Appeal Court affirms EFCC’s power to prosecute cases of tax evasion
n1564ce9bdc.summary: The Court of Appeal in Abuja affirmed the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission's power to prosecute tax evasion cases.
n1564ce9bdc.why: Enforcement rulings on tax evasion affect corporate compliance and tax collection risk for companies operating in Nigeria.

nc1597c442f.headline: Revenues slide by 30% to €25m at Irish arm of Dyson due to
nc1597c442f.summary: Revenues at the Irish arm of Dyson, owned by billionaire James Dyson, slid 30% to €25 million.
nc1597c442f.why: Dyson is a privately owned appliance maker best known for its bagless vacuum cleaners.

n1a01b9f8dc.headline: First Deputy Managing Director Gita Gopinath leaving IMF to rejoin Harvard
n1a01b9f8dc.summary: The IMF announced on July 21 that First Deputy Managing Director Gita Gopinath will leave the Fund at the end of her term to rejoin Harvard.
n1a01b9f8dc.why: The IMF's senior leadership shapes global economic surveillance and lending policy, and its top officials are closely watched by investors.

n69f204cf10.headline: Govt working on modalities to mandate green steel public procurement: Official
n69f204cf10.summary: The Indian government is exploring mandatory public procurement of green steel to shift from traditional carbon steel, with a Green Steel Mission budget of Rs 15,000 crore planned.
n69f204cf10.why: Public procurement rules can create guaranteed demand for lower-carbon steel, influencing producers' investment in cleaner production.

n09e6720942.headline: SpaceX probes for cause of Starlink's global satellite network outage
n09e6720942.summary: SpaceX's Starlink network was back up on Friday while engineers investigated the root cause of one of its biggest international outages. The outage was global.
n09e6720942.why: Starlink is SpaceX's satellite internet service, which serves millions of customers and is an increasingly important telecom provider.

n6f9643648d.headline: Realty Firm Mahindra Lifespace Developers Reports Fourfold Jump In Net Profit To ₹51.26 Crore
n6f9643648d.summary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers reported a fourfold jump in net profit to ₹51.26 crore. The company said an exceptional gain of Rs 24.52 crore, from modified terms on non-convertible debentures in the June quarter, contributed.
n6f9643648d.why: Mahindra Lifespace Developers is a listed Indian real estate developer, and its profit reflects both property sales and one-off items. Investors track its results as a read on India's housing market.

n52308f520f.headline: India pledges Ksh.73 billion to Maldives to boost defence, infrastructure
n52308f520f.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi offered Ksh.73 billion to the Maldives on Friday to bolster its defence forces and infrastructure. The Maldives is a small, strategically located neighbour of India.
n52308f520f.why: Financial aid packages between neighbouring governments can shape infrastructure contracts and regional trade and security alignment. Investors in the region watch such commitments for project and construction flows.

ndfd1df87f9.headline: DWP warned long-standing state pension rule 'must go'
ndfd1df87f9.summary: A recent Office for Budget Responsibility report has led to warnings that the state pension triple lock could become unsustainable. The DWP has been told the rule must change.
ndfd1df87f9.why: The triple lock guarantees annual state pension increases, so its cost feeds into UK public spending and fiscal policy. The Office for Budget Responsibility is the UK's independent fiscal watchdog.

n831445fc18.headline: Donanemab receives positive opinion from the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) in early symptomatic Alzheimer
n831445fc18.summary: The EMA's CHMP gave a positive opinion on donanemab for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease. Eli Lilly announced the opinion, which is a step toward European approval.
n831445fc18.why: Eli Lilly is a US drugmaker, and European approval would open a major new market for its Alzheimer's therapy.

impacts.name: Eli Lilly
impacts.why: A positive regulatory opinion is a step toward approval for a key drug in a new market.

nc659639e20.headline: Matcha: World's thirst for the tea swallows global supplies
nc659639e20.summary: Surging global demand, smaller tea crops hit by heatwaves and US tariffs on Japan are pushing up matcha prices. The BBC reports that supplies are struggling to keep pace.
nc659639e20.why: Matcha is a powdered green tea mostly grown in Japan, and its prices reflect agricultural output, demand and trade policy. Tariffs and weather shocks can move prices for specialty food commodities.

n2dfeecd0c3.headline: Senegal's billions in hidden debt – and why it's a headache for the IMF
n2dfeecd0c3.summary: Senegal faces billions of dollars of debt that was hidden by the previous administration. Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko is expected to present a comprehensive economic recovery plan next week.
n2dfeecd0c3.why: Senegal's debt position shapes its relationship with the IMF and the terms on which it can borrow from international investors.

n6332ab8e6f.headline: Why Toyota Motor Rallied This Week
n6332ab8e6f.summary: Toyota Motor shares rallied during the week after the Trump administration and Japan struck a trade deal that was better than feared. The Motley Fool attributed the gain to the deal.
n6332ab8e6f.why: Toyota is one of Japan's largest automakers and exporters, so changes to US tariffs on Japanese vehicles directly affect its US sales and margins.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor
impacts.why: The report says Toyota shares rallied after a trade deal that was better than feared.

n6332ab8e6f.why_moved: The US-Japan trade deal was reported as better than feared, which lifted Toyota shares during the week.

n2adcdcfe76.headline: Markets Fall For 2nd Day Amid Weak Global Cues & FII Outflows, Sensex Tanks 721 Points; Nifty Hits Monthly Low
n2adcdcfe76.summary: Indian benchmark indices fell for a second day on weak global cues, disappointing earnings and foreign fund outflows. Bajaj Finance and IT stocks led the decline, with the Nifty at a monthly low.
n2adcdcfe76.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking 30 large Indian companies and serving as a key gauge of domestic equity sentiment.

impacts.name: Bajaj Finance
impacts.why: Bajaj Finance was named as one of the leading decliners in the session.

n2adcdcfe76.why_moved: Weak global cues, disappointing earnings and foreign institutional fund outflows drove the sell-off, with Bajaj Finance and IT stocks leading the decline.

nb7b2a5cf48.headline: Dollar rallies against yen
nb7b2a5cf48.summary: The US dollar extended its rally against the yen for a second day, nearing 148.00 after erasing weekly losses. Higher US Treasury yields and fading trade-deal optimism supported the move.
nb7b2a5cf48.why: The dollar-yen pair reflects the interest-rate gap between the US and Japan and is closely watched by global investors and exporters.
nb7b2a5cf48.why_moved: US Treasury yields picked up while optimism about this week's trade deals faded, supporting the dollar against the yen.

n3e1b9ce64c.headline: Here are 5 properties you could buy with $400,000 — the median sales price for a Chicago home
n3e1b9ce64c.summary: The Chicago Association of Realtors said the median sales price for a Chicago home rose by nearly 6% year over year in June, to about $400,000.
n3e1b9ce64c.why: Home prices indicate household wealth and mortgage demand, and they feed into housing-sector and consumer spending trends.

n30faa4f239.headline: Bursa Malaysia ends lower as investors await US tariff outcome, policy clarity
n30faa4f239.summary: Bursa Malaysia closed lower on Friday after two sessions of gains, as investors took profits while Malaysia and the United States negotiate a 20 per cent tariff rate.
n30faa4f239.why: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, a trade-exposed Southeast Asian economy. Its index moves reflect investor sentiment toward trade policy and global demand.
n30faa4f239.why_moved: Investors took profits after two sessions of gains and adopted a wait-and-see stance while Malaysia and the United States negotiate a 20 per cent tariff rate.

nc209929d0c.headline: First HoldCo: SEC grants ‘no objection’ to transaction
nc209929d0c.summary: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission issued a clarification on its role and regulatory stance in the recent First HoldCo transaction. The statement responds to public speculation and misinterpretation.
nc209929d0c.why: First HoldCo is a Nigerian financial holding company, and regulatory approvals for its transactions affect investor confidence in Nigeria's financial sector.

source.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

sources.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

n4d83b8f30a.headline: COCOBOD Sensitises Farmers on Producer Price Ahead of New Crop Year
n4d83b8f30a.summary: COCOBOD is running a sensitisation drive for cocoa farmers on the producer price ahead of the closure of the 2024/2025 crop year, according to the Ghana News Agency.
n4d83b8f30a.why: Ghana is one of the world's largest cocoa producers, and the producer price it sets determines farmer income and influences global cocoa supply and prices.

n3935618eb6.headline: FIRS wants banks and fintechs to share transaction data for VAT monitoring
n3935618eb6.summary: The Federal Inland Revenue Service has built a portal to monitor all VAT electronic transactions and has directed banks, card schemes, fintechs and PSPs to integrate with it.
n3935618eb6.why: Banks and fintechs handle payment flows, so mandated data integration raises their compliance and technology costs and changes how tax is collected.

n85356a5bff.headline: Retrust Microfinance Bank defies odds, grows balance sheet organically to ₦8.9 billion in under six months
n85356a5bff.summary: Retrust Microfinance Bank says it has organically grown its balance sheet to ₦8.9 billion, about $5.7 million, in just under six months of operations.
n85356a5bff.why: Microfinance banks provide small loans and savings products to underserved customers, and their growth reflects demand in Nigeria's financial inclusion market.

n5e03e9f756.headline: Australia’s EV transition is stuck in the slow lane
n5e03e9f756.summary: Australia risks a chicken-and-egg problem in which weak EV demand holds back charging infrastructure, and a lack of infrastructure in turn holds back demand.
n5e03e9f756.why: The pace of electric vehicle adoption shapes demand for automakers, battery supply chains and charging network operators.

n754fc010ad.headline: 'Urgent reformation' of property tax needed to revitalise market - News
n754fc010ad.summary: The IPOA has proposed practical measures to level the playing field for landlords and make Ireland's rental market more sustainable, calling for urgent reform of property tax.
n754fc010ad.why: Rental market rules and taxation shape housing supply, rents and the returns available to property investors.

n56eb8f326b.headline: Australia steps up US trade beef as Trump claims win
n56eb8f326b.summary: Australia has criticised the United States for using its size and might to disrupt international trade through tariffs. Australia is stepping up trade in beef with the US as Trump claims a win.
n56eb8f326b.why: Beef is a major Australian agricultural export, and US tariff policy affects the pricing and volumes of meat trade between the two countries.

n2bb4c41b26.headline: Further 1.6 Billion Euros from EU Recovery Plan for Austria
n2bb4c41b26.summary: The EU Commission approved Austria's second payment request for grants of 1.6 billion euros under the NextGeneration EU recovery plan. The approval came on Friday.
n2bb4c41b26.why: NextGenerationEU is the EU's roughly 800 billion euro recovery fund, financed by joint borrowing, and disbursements to member states depend on approved reform and investment milestones.

na0a914b354.headline: Chinese e-commerce leaders brush off regulatory risk to continue ‘instant retail’ price war
na0a914b354.summary: China's largest e-commerce platforms show no sign of halting an instant retail price war, despite state criticism, signalling how central instant retail is to their strategy.
na0a914b354.why: China's e-commerce platforms are major consumer and retail businesses, and price wars shape their margins and competitive positions.

n64753b1da6.headline: Rupee weakens 12 paise to settle at 86.52 against US dollar
n64753b1da6.summary: The rupee fell 12 paise to close at 86.52 against the US dollar, reflecting a stronger American currency, foreign fund outflows and geopolitical tensions.
n64753b1da6.why: The rupee's value against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets.
n64753b1da6.why_moved: The rupee weakened as the US dollar strengthened and foreign funds withdrew money. Geopolitical tensions added to the pressure.

nbd0c9b9cf6.headline: Consumer credit law risks squeezing poorer households further, says think tank
nbd0c9b9cf6.summary: The Institute for Strategic Analysis and Policy Research said legislation alone will not fix structural issues pushing Malaysians, especially youth and informal workers, into debt cycles.
nbd0c9b9cf6.why: Consumer credit rules shape household borrowing and lending, which matters for Malaysian banks and non-bank lenders.

n14281e5492.headline: B.C., Canada strengthen support for farmers dealing with unexpected losses
n14281e5492.summary: The governments of British Columbia and Canada are changing the AgriStability program to provide more financial support to B.C. farmers facing unexpected losses.
n14281e5492.why: AgriStability is a federal-provincial program that protects Canadian farm income against margin declines, affecting agricultural producers and food supply.

nc3c190312c.headline: Oil Prices Climb Amid U.S.-EU Trade Hopes and Russian Export Restrictions
nc3c190312c.summary: Oil prices rose on renewed U.S.-EU trade optimism, tighter global fuel inventories and expectations of Russian export restrictions. The report cites these factors as drivers of the rally.
nc3c190312c.why: Brent crude, priced in London, is the main global oil benchmark and influences energy costs, inflation and fuel-sector earnings worldwide.
nc3c190312c.why_moved: Renewed U.S.-EU trade optimism, tighter global fuel inventories and expectations of Russian export restrictions are cited as the drivers of the price rise.

n7144fafc89.headline: Pag-IBIG offers 3% housing loan rate under 4PH program
n7144fafc89.summary: The Pag-IBIG Fund announced a subsidised interest rate of 3% a year for the first five years on housing loans. The rate applies under the Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino programme.
n7144fafc89.why: Pag-IBIG is the Philippines' state housing fund, and its loan rates influence housing finance and construction demand.

nb3cdd2c053.headline: Tokyo inflation slows while staying well above BOJ’s target
nb3cdd2c053.summary: Tokyo consumer inflation slowed, helped by a decline in utility costs. The gauge remains well above the Bank of Japan's target as households still face higher living costs.
nb3cdd2c053.why: Tokyo consumer prices are a leading indicator of national inflation, which guides Bank of Japan policy on interest rates. Inflation trends affect yen valuations and Japanese bond yields.

n092e2dcf10.headline: New rail spur line aims to connect Coaldale to global markets  | Globalnews.ca
n092e2dcf10.summary: The Alberta government is investing several million dollars to link a $222 million cold storage facility in Coaldale with the nearby CP rail line.
n092e2dcf10.why: Rail access lowers logistics costs for agricultural and food exporters. Public infrastructure investment can improve regional supply-chain connections.

na9c0882145.headline: LT Foods posts record Q1 revenue, shares flat
na9c0882145.summary: LT Foods reported record Q1 FY26 revenue of ₹2,501 crore, EBITDA of ₹302 crore, and 9% profit after tax growth, but shares remained flat.
na9c0882145.why: LT Foods is a major Indian food company; strong revenue and profit growth indicate operational strength despite flat share price.

n89f3dbc3ba.headline: Office space leasing in Delhi-NCR more than double in Apr-Jun to 2.62 mn sq ft: Vestian
n89f3dbc3ba.summary: Vestian reports a 10% rise in office space leasing across India's top markets, with Delhi-NCR leasing more than doubling to 2.62 million square feet in April-June quarter.
n89f3dbc3ba.why: Rising office leasing indicates improving commercial real estate demand and economic activity in India's major urban centers.

ne9a2fae57c.headline: Swiggy recasts board following IPO; SoftBank, Accel nominees exit
ne9a2fae57c.summary: Following its IPO, Swiggy saw the resignation of SoftBank and Accel nominees from its board, marking a shift in its governance structure.
ne9a2fae57c.why: Swiggy is a major Indian food delivery platform; board changes post-IPO can affect strategic direction and investor confidence.

nf1f9d2c2ac.headline: RBI won battle against inflation, war continues, Governor Sanjay Malhotra says
nf1f9d2c2ac.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that while inflation has been controlled, price stability remains the central bank's top priority.
nf1f9d2c2ac.why: The RBI is India's central bank responsible for monetary policy and inflation control, which directly impacts economic growth and financial markets.

n088279d3f1.headline: In China, repair demand for banned Nvidia AI chipsets booms
n088279d3f1.summary: Despite US export bans, China’s repair industry for Nvidia AI chipsets is booming.
n088279d3f1.why: The demand for repair of banned chipsets reflects ongoing technology supply chain tensions and adaptation in China’s tech sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Repair demand indicates ongoing use despite export restrictions.
